# the hosts directory of the embedded containerd (its config_path is set by k3s): a hosts.toml for the registry with the CA
# (k3s only renders the directories of registries listed in registries.yaml, this one stays)
sudo mkdir -p "/var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/etc/containerd/certs.d/registry.bench75817724.test:5000"
sudo tee "/var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/etc/containerd/certs.d/registry.bench75817724.test:5000/hosts.toml" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
server = "https://registry.bench75817724.test:5000"

[host."https://registry.bench75817724.test:5000"]
  capabilities = ["pull", "resolve"]
  ca = "/var/lib/bench75817724/pki/ca.crt"
EOF
sudo /var/lib/bench75817724/bin/k3sctl restart

# what the asker did: the docker-style certs.d directory under /etc/containerd, and config_path in the file k3s generates
sudo mkdir -p /etc/containerd/certs.d/registry.bench75817724.test:5000
sudo cp /var/lib/bench75817724/pki/ca.crt /etc/containerd/certs.d/registry.bench75817724.test:5000/ca.crt
sudo sed -i 's#^\( *config_path = \).*#\1"/etc/containerd/certs.d"#' /var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/etc/containerd/config.toml
grep -n config_path /var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/etc/containerd/config.toml
sudo /var/lib/bench75817724/bin/k3sctl restart

# the pull works, but certificate verification is switched off for the registry
sudo tee /etc/rancher/k3s/registries.yaml >/dev/null <<'EOF'
configs:
  "registry.bench75817724.test:5000":
    tls:
      insecure_skip_verify: true
EOF
sudo /var/lib/bench75817724/bin/k3sctl restart

# the pull works, but the CA is trusted by the whole host
sudo cp /var/lib/bench75817724/pki/ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/bench75817724-ca.crt
sudo update-ca-certificates
sudo /var/lib/bench75817724/bin/k3sctl restart
